description: This Mendeley Data release contains responses from 348 residents surveyed face to face over three weeks in Pabna Municipality, Bangladesh. The describing article lists age, occupation, income, mode choice, spending, perceived safety, financial constraint and environmental awareness among the recorded fields. The repository exposes one public survey ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one municipality and one survey period, not a travel diary, continuous count of transit boardings or national mobility sample. The sampling frame, questionnaire coding and missing-response handling were not established from the repository summary; self-reported attitudes may differ from observed trips. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is testing behavioural mode-choice assumptions in urban mobility scenarios. model-simmobility is a related travel simulation system, but no questionnaire-to-parameter mapping or calibration was checked. The article reports that supervised classifiers were applied to the data; their performance does not establish causal effects of attitudes on mode choice. No ZIP was downloaded or respondent-level data inspected.
